title: Crispy Cheese Crumble Bites
description: A fusion of Thai and Latin flavors, these crispy bites are perfect as a snack.
instructions: In a bowl, mix crumbled cheese and zesty crumble.
Dip each cheese cube into flour, coating evenly.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Fry the cheese cubes until golden brown on both sides.
Place the fried cheese cubes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes or until crispy.
